about.title: About {store}
about.lead: Ramachandrapuram's sports hub since 2015 – built on trust, genuine products and strong relationships with local athletes.
about.company: {store} is a premier retail destination dedicated to providing high-quality sports equipment, athletic apparel, fitness gear, and footwear. Catering to beginners, amateur enthusiasts, school/college teams, and professional athletes alike, we offer a wide range of authentic products across major sports such as cricket, football, badminton, tennis, swimming, and gym fitness. Our focus is on combining top-tier brands, expert product guidance, and competitive pricing under one roof.
about.journeyTitle: From a neighbourhood outlet to a sports hub
about.journey: Founded in the year 2015 with a passion for promoting fitness and sporting excellence in Ramachandrapuram, Andhra Pradesh, {store} began as a modest neighborhood sports outlet. Over the years, driven by trust, genuine products, and strong relationships with local athletes, schools, and sports academies, we have grown into a well-recognised sports hub. Today, we continue to expand our product range and serve a loyal community of sports lovers across the region.

timeline.foundedBody: Founded as a neighbourhood sports outlet in Ramachandrapuram.
timeline.growthBody: Partnerships with schools & academies across the region.
timeline.todayBody: A well-recognised sports hub of the region.

about.missionTitle: Helping every player play their best
about.mission: Our mission is to inspire and empower athletes of every age and skill level by making high-performance, authentic sports and fitness gear accessible and affordable. We strive to deliver exceptional customer service, expert advice, and reliable equipment that helps every customer play their best and lead an active, healthy lifestyle.

terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.intro: Welcome to {store}. By accessing our website or placing an order, you agree to the following Terms of Sale.

s1.title: Product Information
s1.b1: We make every effort to display accurate product descriptions, images, specifications and prices. However, slight variations in colour, appearance or packaging may occur due to photography, screen settings or manufacturer updates.

s2.title: Pricing and Payments
s2.b1: All prices are displayed in Indian Rupees (INR). Orders are subject to product availability and successful payment confirmation. Any applicable shipping charges or additional fees will be displayed during checkout.

s3.title: Order Confirmation
s3.b1: Once an order is placed, you will receive an order confirmation through the contact details provided. {store} reserves the right to contact customers for order verification or clarification.

s4.title: Order Cancellation
s4.b1: Cancellation requests should be made as early as possible. Orders that have already been dispatched may not be eligible for cancellation and may instead be subject to our Returns and Refunds Policy.

s5.title: Shipping and Delivery
s5.b1: Orders are shipped through our logistics partner, Shiprocket. Estimated delivery timelines, shipping conditions and tracking information are explained in our Delivery Policy.

s6.title: Returns and Refunds
s6.b1: All return, replacement and refund requests are governed by our Returns and Refunds Policy.

s7.title: Customer Responsibility
s7.b1: Customers are responsible for providing accurate shipping addresses, contact numbers and other required details while placing an order.

s8.title: Changes to Terms
s8.b1: {store} reserves the right to update these Terms of Sale when necessary. Updated terms will be published on this website.

terms.outro: For any questions regarding your purchase, please contact us through our official contact details.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At {store}, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us.

s1.title: Information We Collect
s1.b1: When you visit our website or place an order, we may collect:
s1.b6: Information voluntarily shared through our contact forms

s2.title: How We Use Your Information
s2.b1: We use the information collected to:
s2.b4: Provide order updates and tracking information.
s2.b5: Respond to customer enquiries and complaints.
s2.b6: Improve our website and shopping experience.
s2.b7: Meet applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

s3.title: Sharing of Information
s3.b1: We may share necessary customer information with trusted third-party service providers, including Shiprocket and relevant delivery partners, payment gateways and website service providers, strictly where required to process orders, payments and deliveries or provide our services.
s3.b2: We do not sell customers' personal information to third parties.

s4.title: Payment Security
s4.b1: Online payments are processed through the payment service providers available on our website. We do not intend to store customers' complete card details, UPI PINs or banking passwords.

s5.title: Data Protection
s5.b1: We take reasonable measures to protect customer information against unauthorised access, misuse, disclosure or loss.

s6.title: Cookies
s6.b1: Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to improve website functionality, understand visitor activity and enhance the browsing experience.

s7.title: Your Privacy Rights
s7.b1: You may contact us to request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information, subject to applicable legal requirements and necessary record-retention obligations. You may also raise concerns about how your information is used.

s8.title: Policy Updates
s8.b1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page.

s9.title: Contact Us
s9.b1: For privacy-related questions or concerns, please contact {store} through our official contact details.

shipping.title: Delivery Policy
shipping.intro: At {store}, we aim to deliver your orders safely and efficiently. We work with Shiprocket and its associated courier partners to provide reliable shipping services across our serviceable delivery locations in India.

s1.title: Order Processing
s1.b1: Orders are processed after successful order confirmation and payment verification, where applicable. Processing and dispatch may take additional time during weekends, public holidays, sale periods or unforeseen circumstances.

s2.title: Estimated Delivery Time
s2.b1: Our estimated delivery time is **3–7 working days**, depending on the customer's delivery location and courier serviceability.
s2.b2: Please note that this is an estimated timeframe and not a guaranteed delivery date.

s3.title: Shipping Partner
s3.b1: We use Shiprocket as our shipping and logistics platform to facilitate order dispatch and delivery through available courier partners.

s4.title: Order Tracking
s4.b1: Once your order is dispatched, tracking details will be shared through the available communication channels. Customers can use the tracking information to check their shipment status.

s5.title: Delivery Delays
s5.b1: Although we make every effort to deliver orders within the estimated timeframe, delays may occasionally occur due to weather conditions, public holidays, operational issues, courier disruptions or circumstances beyond our control.

s6.title: Incorrect Address or Unsuccessful Delivery
s6.b1: Customers are requested to provide accurate shipping details while placing an order. Delays or failed deliveries caused by incorrect addresses, unavailable recipients or unsuccessful delivery attempts may require additional coordination with the courier partner.

s7.title: Damaged or Missing Packages
s7.b1: If your package arrives visibly damaged, tampered with or incomplete, please contact us as soon as possible with your order details and supporting photographs or an unboxing video, where available.

s8.title: Contact for Delivery Support
s8.b1: For shipping or tracking-related assistance, please contact {store} through our official contact details.

legal.title: Legal Notice
legal.intro: All content displayed on the {store} website, including text, product descriptions, images, graphics, logos and website design, is intended for general informational and commercial purposes.

s1.title: Intellectual Property
s1.b1: Unless otherwise stated, website content, branding and original materials belonging to {store} may not be copied, reproduced, distributed or used for commercial purposes without prior written permission.

s2.title: Product Representation
s2.b1: We make reasonable efforts to ensure that product information, images and descriptions are accurate. Minor variations in colour, appearance or packaging may occur due to display settings, photography or manufacturer changes.

s3.title: Third-Party Services
s3.b1: Our website may use third-party services, including payment providers and shipping partners such as Shiprocket. These services may operate under their own terms, conditions and privacy policies.

s4.title: Website Availability
s4.b1: We make reasonable efforts to maintain website availability and functionality. However, temporary interruptions may occur due to maintenance, technical issues or circumstances beyond our control.

s5.title: Limitation of Liability
s5.b1: Nothing in this notice is intended to exclude or restrict any consumer rights or legal remedies available under applicable Indian law.

s6.title: Governing Law
s6.b1: These website policies and transactions shall be governed by the applicable laws of India.

s7.title: Contact Information
s7.b1: For legal or general enquiries, please contact {store} through the official contact details provided on our website.

returns.title: Returns and Refunds Policy
returns.intro: At {store}, customer satisfaction is our priority. We strive to provide quality products and a smooth shopping experience. If you encounter any issues with your purchase, please review our Returns and Refunds Policy below.

s1.title: Return Period
s1.b1: Customers may request a return or replacement within **7 days from the date of delivery** of their order, subject to the eligibility conditions mentioned in this policy.
s1.b2: Requests submitted after this period may not be accepted, except where required under applicable law.

s2.title: Eligible Reasons for Returns
s2.b1: A return or replacement request may be considered in the following situations:
s2.b2: The product received is damaged or defective.
s2.b3: The wrong product has been delivered.
s2.b4: The product received is significantly different from its description on our website.
s2.b5: An item is missing from the delivered order.
s2.b6: All requests will be reviewed before approval.

s3.title: Conditions for Returns
s3.b1: To be eligible for a return:
s3.b2: The product should be unused and in its original condition, wherever applicable.
s3.b3: Original packaging, tags, accessories and invoice should be included, wherever applicable.
s3.b4: The product must not have been damaged due to misuse, mishandling or unauthorised modifications by the customer.
s3.b5: These conditions do not limit any rights available to customers under applicable consumer protection laws.

s4.title: How to Request a Return
s4.b1: To initiate a return or replacement, customers must contact {store} within **7 days of receiving the product**.

s5.title: Refund Policy
s5.b1: Once a return and refund request is approved and the returned product has been received and inspected, the refund will be initiated.
s5.b2: Refunds will be processed through the **original payment method used while placing the order**, wherever technically possible.
s5.b3: The time taken for the refund to reflect in your account may vary depending on your bank or payment service provider.
s5.b4: Customers will be informed once the refund has been initiated.
s5.b5: For Cash on Delivery orders, the customer may be asked to provide valid bank account details for processing an approved refund, as no original electronic payment method exists.

s6.title: Replacement Policy
s6.b1: If a product is damaged, defective or incorrectly delivered, a replacement may be arranged, subject to product availability and approval of the request.
s6.b2: If a replacement is unavailable, an appropriate refund or other resolution will be provided in accordance with applicable law.

s7.title: Non-Eligible Return Situations
s7.b1: Returns may not be accepted for:
s7.b2: Products damaged due to improper use or accidental damage after delivery.
s7.b3: Products showing signs of unauthorised alteration or modification.
s7.b4: Issues arising from normal wear and tear.
s7.b5: Products returned without the required accessories or components, where their absence affects the return assessment.
s7.b6: This section does not exclude remedies that customers are legally entitled to receive.

s8.title: Order Cancellation
s8.b1: Cancellation requests should be submitted before the order is dispatched. Once an order has been dispatched, cancellation may no longer be possible and the request will be handled under the applicable return policy and consumer protection requirements.

s9.title: Contact Us
s9.b1: For any questions or assistance regarding returns, replacements or refunds, please contact {store} through the official contact details provided on our website.

returns.outro: We appreciate your trust in {store} and thank you for shopping with us.
